compendium.summary: High-level magical shutdown with severe self-limits.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Pre-cast gate: List which personal spells, items, movement, communication, and escape tools it suppresses.
Failure state: The Wizard disables their own survival kit and cannot end the encounter.
Safe operating default: Enter only with mundane protection, ally coordination, and a route out.
